title: Frequency-Aware Continual Learning for Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart contract vulnerability detection with Large Language Models (LLMs) faces three causally linked challenges. First, new vulnerability categories demand parameter-efficient adaptation, since full retraining is prohibitive for sequentially arriving tasks. Second, training per-task adapters on a shared backbone causes catastrophic forgetting of previously learned vulnerabilities. Third, the resulting multiplicity of adapters must be consolidated into a single model, since task identity is unknown at inference time. translated_title: 面向智能合约漏洞检测的频率感知持续学习与大语言模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于大语言模型（LLMs）的智能合约漏洞检测面临三个因果关联的挑战。首先，新的漏洞类别需要参数高效的适应性调整，因为对顺序到达的任务进行完全重新训练是不可行的。其次，在共享骨干网络上训练每个任务的适配器会导致对先前学习到的漏洞的灾难性遗忘。第三，由此产生的多个适配器必须整合成一个单一模型，因为推理时任务身份未知。每个挑战直接源于前一个挑战的解决方案，这使得一个集成框架至关重要。我们提出一个三阶段流水线，其中每个阶段解决一个挑战并馈入下一个阶段。适应阶段使用频率感知低秩适应（FA-LoRA），该方法在傅里叶域中进行适应，并带有每频率重要性门控，仅需0.4%的可训练参数，同时性能优于现有方法。
tldr: 本文提出一个三阶段持续学习框架，利用频率感知低秩适应（FA-LoRA）在傅里叶域进行参数高效调整，仅用0.4%可训练参数实现智能合约漏洞检测的持续学习，同时解决灾难性遗忘和模型整合问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-stage continual learning framework using Frequency-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation (FA-LoRA) in the Fourier domain for parameter-efficient adaptation, achieving smart contract vulnerability detection with only 0.4% trainable parameters while addressing catastrophic forgetting and model consolidation.
